title: Billing Reference: Unused Share of a Cancelled Harbison Labor-Only Protection Contract
content:
**Clause.** On the cancellation of a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the unused share applies by multiplication to the contract price. The unused share depends on how long the holder has held the contract, in whole calendar months from the purchase date to the date of confirmation:

| Whole calendar months held | Unused share |
|---|---|
| more than 36 months | the **daily share**: the calendar days from the refund start date through the coverage end, both counted, divided by the calendar days from the coverage start through the coverage end, both counted |
| 12 months or fewer | the **short-rate share** of 0.90 of the whole-month share: the whole-month share multiplied by 0.90 |
| more than 12 and up to 36 months | the **whole-month share**: the complete month-to-month steps from the refund start date that end on or before the coverage end, divided by the term's months (the tier's labor coverage years times twelve) |

A contract still pending counts its whole term as unused, so its unused share is one.

**Both sides of each threshold.** 12 months held: short-rate share. 13 months: whole-month share. 36 months: whole-month share. 37 months: daily share.

**Worked figures (hypothetical contracts; refund start date taken as the date of confirmation, 15 March 2026).**

| Purchase date | Months held | Coverage | Unused share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 September 2025 | 6 | 1 September 2025 to 31 August 2030, term's months 60 | 53 complete steps (the step ending 15 August 2030 is the last on or before 31 August 2030), 53 divided by 60 multiplied by 0.90, that is 0.795 |
| 10 January 2024 | 26 | 10 January 2024 to 9 January 2029, term's months 60 | 33 complete steps (to 15 December 2028), 33 divided by 60, that is 0.55 |
| 1 July 2020 | 68 | 1 July 2020 to 30 June 2030 | 1569 days (15 March 2026 through 30 June 2030) divided by 3652 days (1 July 2020 through 30 June 2030), about 0.4296 |
